rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: Under the heading 'भारतीय जनता पार्टी संगठनात्मक चुनाव वर्ष–2013 / राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष का निर्वाचन' (BJP organisational elections 2013: election of the National President), the National Election Officer states that 'आज दिनांक 23 जनवरी, 2013 (बुधवार)' (today, Wednesday 23 January 2013) the constitutional process of electing the National President was completed at the party headquarters, 11 Ashoka Road, New Delhi, and that 'श्री राजनाथ सिंह जी' (Shri Rajnath Singh) was elected unanimously to the post for the session 2013-2015.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the same document the officer declares 'श्री राजनाथ सिंह जी' elected unopposed ('निर्विरोध निर्वाचित') as National President for the session 2013-2015 and says the certificate of election is being sent accordingly; it is signed '(थावरचन्द गेहलोत) राष्ट्रीय चुनाव अधिकारी' (Thawarchand Gehlot, National Election Officer).
